name: Triangulation Improvement via Isosurface Projection
aliases: Moving dual vertices to the isosurface
definition: A post-processing step to reduce sliver triangles by moving dual vertices onto the isosurface while keeping them within their respective cells.
summary: Triangulation Improvement via Isosurface Projection is a post-processing step that reduces sliver triangles by moving dual vertices onto the isosurface while ensuring topological safety.
